title: Very Cute!
text: Very Cute!. My daughter is renting an older house near campus. It was built in the 1950's and is a bit drafty around the doors. This door draft stopper is very cute. It fits along her door pretty well. It's weighted so it stays put, but at the same time, it's easy to push with the door when opening it. She would love to have a cat, but her roommate is allergic to cats, so this will have to do!
